customrecordtype.description: Configuration for Click-to-Call. Managed exclusively by the Setup Wizard SPA. Hidden from admin UI via allowuiaccess=F; edit only via the wizard. Runtime reads remain open (accesstype=NONENEEDED) so non-admin scripts (poller, softphone, phone-button) can read config without role-checking workarounds (per SAFE Guide §5.2).

customrecordcustomfield.label: API Key Secret ID
customrecordcustomfield.description: Script ID from Setup > Company > API Secrets (e.g., custsecret_ctc_api_key_secret)

customrecordcustomfield.label: CTC Activated
customrecordcustomfield.description: Flipped to T by the v2 Setup Wizard when all preflight checks pass. The phone-icon User Event script reads this flag and stays hidden until activation succeeds, so reps never see a half-configured icon. Default F on fresh installs.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Calls Enabled
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked, the phone token lets Twilio ring the rep's browser phone (client identity = employee internal id) for inbound calls. Default F: outbound only.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Ring Seconds
customrecordcustomfield.description: How long an inbound call rings the assigned rep's browser phone before the caller hears the no-answer message. Whole seconds, 10 to 60. Blank means 20.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound No-Answer Message
customrecordcustomfield.description: Spoken to an inbound caller when the rep does not answer or the dialed number has no rep. Blank means the built-in default message.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Studio Flow SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: SID (FW...) of the Twilio Studio flow that NetSuite generates and publishes for inbound routing. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Routing Published At
customrecordcustomfield.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful publish of the inbound routing flow. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Record Inbound Calls
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked, the inbound routing flow records each answered inbound call (Studio Connect Call To with Record on) so it is transcribed and analyzed like an outbound call. Checked by default.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Play Inbound Recording Notice
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked and inbound recording is on, every inbound caller hears the recording notice once before the rep's phone rings. Checked by default.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Recording Notice
customrecordcustomfield.description: Spoken to an inbound caller before the call is connected and recorded. Blank means the built-in notice.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Call Reconciliation Watermark
customrecordcustomfield.description: ISO 8601 UTC time. Every Twilio browser call that ended before this time has a Phone Call. Written by the transcript poller (call reconciliation). Blank means the next run looks back 7 days.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Voicemail
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked, an inbound caller who is not answered (or who calls a number with no rep) hears the no-answer message, then can leave a voicemail. The voicemail is transcribed and logged as a Phone Call. When not checked, the caller hears the no-answer message and the call ends. Checked by default.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Voicemail Max Length (Seconds)
customrecordcustomfield.description: Longest voicemail a caller can leave, in whole seconds, 30 to 300. Blank means 120.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Fallback Call Owner
customrecordcustomfield.description: Employee who owns the Phone Call for inbound calls and voicemails to a number with no rep, and for calls whose rep is inactive. Blank means such calls are not logged.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Play Outbound Recording Notice
customrecordcustomfield.description: When checked (and the outbound Twilio Function is published), the person a rep calls hears the outbound recording notice after they answer and before the call is connected and recorded. Not checked by default.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Recording Notice
customrecordcustomfield.description: Spoken to the called party on outbound calls, 300 characters or fewer. Blank means the built-in notice.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Notice Version
customrecordcustomfield.description: Version of the outbound notice settings. The Setup Wizard adds 1 each time the notice text or the on/off setting changes. Blank means 1.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Notice Version Live
customrecordcustomfield.description: Notice version that the last successful publish put live in Twilio. Blank or 0 means no notice plays. Written by the Setup Wizard; logCall copies it to the Phone Call.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Service SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: SID (ZS...) of the Twilio Serverless service ctc-outbound that serves the outbound TwiML. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Environment SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: SID (ZE...) of the production environment of the ctc-outbound service. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Build SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: SID (ZB...) of the build that is deployed. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Pending Build SID
customrecordcustomfield.description: SID (ZB...) of a build that was still running when a publish request ended. The next publish with resume finishes it. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Domain
customrecordcustomfield.description: Domain of the ctc-outbound environment (for example ctc-outbound-1234-prod.twil.io). The TwiML App Voice URL is https://DOMAIN/dial. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Code Version
customrecordcustomfield.description: Function code version (FN_CODE_VERSION) at the last publish. When it differs from the installed SuiteApp, the Setup Wizard asks for a republish.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Code Hash
customrecordcustomfield.description: Hash of the Function code and runtime at the last publish. An unchanged hash skips the upload and build.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Previous TwiML App Voice URL
customrecordcustomfield.description: Voice URL of the TwiML App before the first publish of the outbound Function. Unpublish restores it.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Outbound Function Published At
customrecordcustomfield.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful publish of the outbound Function. Written by the Setup Wizard.

customrecordcustomfield.label: Inbound Routing State
customrecordcustomfield.description: JSON written after each inbound routing publish: result (ok, partial or failed), hashes of the published routing, routed numbers and reps, flow revision and times. The Setup Wizard health check compares it with the current rep assignments. Do not edit.
